desc: A legendary lunar witch, small humanoid girl in a deep navy hooded cloak with crescent moon embroidery, long silver hair, sleepy pink eyes, holding a short crescent staff. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no props, no background.
